name: Lead Review
subtitle: The leads your agents found, prioritized, with the top few activity-checked.
summary: Pulls the latest leads your signal agents deposited, explains why each matched, and live-checks the top few to confirm they're actually active before you spend time on them. If no agent has found anything yet, it tells you what to set up first.
howToAsk: Which of my leads are worth contacting first?
get: scored leads with match reasons, top candidates activity-checked, and your fit or not-fit verdicts recorded to train the scorer.
launchPrompt: Check whether my signal agents have found any leads yet. If there are some, explain why each matched and verify the top 3 are still active before I reach out. If there are none, tell me what I need to set up first.
